newsitem.title: JAPAN: Showa Denko to build new naphtha cracking furnace.
newsitem.headline: Showa Denko to build new naphtha cracking furnace.

text.p: Showa Denko KK said on Wednesday that it plans to build a new naphtha cracking furnace with a capacity to produce 60,000 tonnes of naphtha annually.
The construction cost of the new furnace, due to be completed in April 1998, is estimated at one to two billion yen, a Showa Denko spokesman said.
Showa Denko currently produces about 730,000 tonnes of naphtha a year at 18 facilities located in two separate ethylene production plants in Oita prefecture on Japan's southern island of Kyushu.

The new facility will be built at one of the plants in Oita. The spokesman said the firm's annual production volume would be unchanged as the new facility was being built to allow maintenance checks at the older facilities.
